objective: Deploy the GAMMA game contracts from this repository exactly as written, without changing their logic. Foundry project at the repository root. Deploy, in order: (1) DrandBeacon (src/DrandBeacon.sol, no constructor arguments), a permissionless verifier of drand evmnet BLS signatures on BN254. (2) GammaGame (src/GammaGame.sol) with constructor (poolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, imd 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, beacon $contract:DrandBeacon, configurator $owner). GammaGame is the proof-of-play mining game for the GAMMA/IMD pool: players buy energies with IMD (bought GAMMA is burned), four machines with 10/30/60/90% fail rates, a fixed 800M GAMMA Reserve released every 10 minutes, survivors split the Shares, failures split the evening Harvest, claim fee 80% to 10% over 24h split burn/unclaimed bonus/Harvest. No owner, no mint, no withdraw; the configurator can only call initialize once. No backend signer. This repository already contains the fixes from launch 2210's audit (see ADAPTATION.md). By design: randomness is drand only, with no block-data fallback, because any fallback gives the settler a choice between two public draws (a late drand round is always provable, so an outage only delays settlement); and hook fees arrive only in GAMMA (the hook refuses exact-output buys), so the game never holds or swaps IMD.
